decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressively utilizing low-cost and efficient creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes a combination of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push to maintain board control. The creatures in the deck have evasion abilities or can generate card advantage to maintain pressure on the opponent. The land base is designed to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and disrupt their game plan while maintaining a consistent and aggressive presence on the battlefield.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field alongside cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Hidden Strings to generate a large amount of mana quickly to enable powerful combo plays. By combining various card draw spells and recursion effects like Dig Through Time and Lier, Disciple of the Drowned, the deck aims to consistently find and execute its combo pieces. The inclusion of spells like Artist's Talent and Thespian's Stage provide additional utility and versatility in navigating different game states. Overall, the deck emphasizes efficient combo setups and resource management to achieve victory.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells and utilizing cards like Opt, Artist's Talent, and Picklock Prankster to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard to deal damage. It also contains cards like Treasure Cruise and Prof's Eidetic Memory to draw more cards, maintaining consistent pressure on the opponent. The deck includes some control elements with cards like Spell Pierce and Fiery Impulse to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient use of resources to secure victory.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent through fast, efficient creatures and burn spells. With cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. In addition, the deck utilizes cards like Infuriate and Reckless Rage to pump up its creatures and remove any blockers in the way. By utilizing Jegantha as a companion, this deck maximizes its potential by having access to a powerful additional card to further its aggro strategy.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to continually tutor for powerful creatures while keeping the opponent's board in check. The key strategy involves sacrificing lower-costing creatures to fetch higher-costing ones, generating value and advantage over time. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value by flickering permanents for extra triggers. The deck also includes a variety of powerful creatures and removal spells to handle different situations, making it a versatile and adaptive control archetype in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the centerpiece for card advantage and control. With a diverse array of spells and creatures, including multicolored cards to trigger Niv-Mizzet's ability, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through a combination of removal, card draw, and powerful threats. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion provides additional value and flexibility in the late game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolor requirements and ensure consistency in casting its spells.

This deck focuses on fast, aggressive gameplay with cards that deal direct damage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It combines efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize with powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester. The mana base is designed to support a quick start with lands like Mutavault and Blightstep Pathway. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional threats and disruption to overwhelm the opponent. The deck seeks to control the board and apply pressure early on to secure a quick victory.

This UW Control deck aims to control the game through counterspells, board wipes, and card advantage. It also utilizes the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard to provide an additional threat and value. The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells like Dovin's Veto, removal like Portable Hole, and card draw with Memory Deluge and Narset, Parter of Veils. The main win condition is to outvalue opponents with planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and finish the game with creatures or direct damage. The deck is designed to outlast opponents and grind out victories.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Valgavoth, Terror Eater from the top of the library. It also utilizes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Torch the Tower to control the board while setting up for explosive combo turns. The deck's mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors for its spells. Overall, the deck aims to surprise opponents with unexpected plays and overwhelm them with a mix of big threats and versatile removal.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play spells, fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenix, and bring them back to the battlefield for fast and aggressive damage. The deck includes a mix of cheap spells for card draw and removal, as well as some high-impact spells like Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass. The inclusion of cards like Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder help accelerate the process of getting Arclight Phoenix into the graveyard and onto the battlefield. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and card advantage.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and utilizing the Companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring to ensure a consistent mana base. The deck contains a mix of low-cost creatures like Callous Sell-Sword and Monastery Swiftspear, along with pump spells like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing efficient creatures and burn spells, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provides additional reach and value in longer games.

The deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle with a mix of creatures and removal spells. Utilizing powerful creatures like Bloodletter of Aclazotz and Unstoppable Slasher, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to control the board early and deal heavy damage to the opponent quickly. The combination of creatures with evasion abilities and direct damage spells make it difficult for opponents to stabilize, putting pressure on them to react to the threats posed by the deck.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards that allow for creative combos and synergies, aiming to outmaneuver opponents with unexpected plays and powerful interactions. The deck includes a mix of cards that support the main strategy of generating value through creative card interactions, as well as cards that disrupt the opponent's game plan. By leveraging the versatility and flexibility of the cards in the deck, players can create unique and powerful board states that give them the edge in one-on-one matches.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with efficient creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan through cards like Archon of Emeria and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggro pressure and disruptive elements, allowing the Selesnya Aggro deck to dictate the pace of the game and come out on top. Collected Company provides additional creature advantage, while cards like Skyclave Apparition offer removal options as needed. This deck aims to win through a combination of speed, resilience, and disruption.

The deck focuses on utilizing a mix of efficient creature choices and disruptive spells to maintain tempo and pressure on the opponent. Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom boost the power of Spirit tribal creatures, while Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition provide removal and disruption. The inclusion of Mutavault and Shacklegeist adds versatility to the deck's game plan, allowing for various strategies to be pursued. By combining aggression with control elements, the deck aims to quickly establish dominance on the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on a versatile control strategy using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful engine for card advantage and selection. With a mix of removal, counterspells, and ramp, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win conditions. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexibility in finding key cards, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value through blinking permanents for extra advantage. By utilizing a mix of multicolor lands and diverse card options, the deck can adapt to various matchups and outmaneuver opponents with its spells.
